title: Ontario municipal systems that convert housing targets into completed units
question: Which municipal systems can convert housing targets into completed units?
why_it_matters: Provincial targets and housing demand matter only if municipal planning, servicing, approvals, infrastructure, labor, and financing can convert them into occupied homes.
current_support: FTFN has Ontario housing supply progress, CMHC and Statistics Canada data, Toronto AIC, the initial notice for application 24 254930, and a June 2026 staff report recommending approval of a revised 510-unit rental proposal with an accepted application-stage servicing analysis.
missing_evidence: final servicing conditions and detailed design
City Council decision and enacted by-laws
candidate_records: Toronto application 24 254930 Council item history and enacted by-laws
next_action: Track application 24 254930 through Council and enacted by-laws, then add land-condition, building-permit, start, completion, and occupancy evidence.
notes: Phase 51 added a staff approval recommendation and project-level servicing review. The gap remains unresolved because the record is not a final Council decision, enacted by-law, building permit, start, completion, occupancy, or province-wide conversion measure.
